subject.title: fix(security): bound plugin manifest reads in audit deep scan

question: Should deep audit treat plugin manifests larger than 1 MiB as unparseable and continue without manifest-declared entrypoint coverage?
rationale: The limit closes an unbounded-read weakness but intentionally reduces explicit coverage for valid oversized manifests whose entrypoints use scanner-skipped paths.

options.title: Accept bounded coverage
options.body: Keep the 1 MiB limit, warning, and directory-only fallback for oversized manifests.

options.title: Preserve declared entries
options.body: Require a different bounded extraction design that retains openclaw.extensions entrypoint coverage.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded coverage
recommendation.body: Keep the 1 MiB limit, warning, and directory-only fallback for oversized manifests.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored and merged the security-hardening behavior whose scan-coverage boundary this PR changes.
